title: The actual marked V4 extension and its cusp-fixing endomorphism
proved_results: The specified G=E semidirect_Theta C2 contains Q0=<s,h tau>=V4 and the positive subgroup G_+=C2(tau) amalg Zhat(p), with explicit full inverse maps and p=x tau, p^2=z^(-1).

The full original z-cusp normalizer is exactly

semidirect_-1 for the fixed original normalized reflection r.
With v=pr, the unique actual g with [g,v]=z supplies q=g^(-1)r, an involution commuting with v, and the specified Q=<q,v>=V4.
The original section parity vectors prove q belongs to the original s class, and select a unique w with q=w s w^(-1). They force g_ab=(a,b) with a+b=-1, a odd and b even.
The actual full map iota:C2 amalg V4 -> G has positive restriction equal, under explicit inverse coproduct maps, to eta:G_+->G_+ with eta(p)=p and eta(tau)=w h tau w^(-1).

The full image of iota is all G exactly when eta is onto, and exactly when eta is an automorphism. The proof includes the finite-open-subgroup Hopf argument; no side of this equivalence is supplied for a remaining input.
On the original F, eta(x)=p g^(-1)p^(-1), eta(y)=g^(-1), and eta(z)=z exactly. Its original abelian determinant is a-b.
The actual beta=Inn(w^(-1))eta_F obeys alpha beta=beta delta and psi beta=beta theta and takes the original z to w^(-1)zw.
Changing r to z^d r z^(-d) transports every selected element explicitly, changes eta by Inn(z^d), and leaves beta exactly unchanged.
For the original standard input h=1 the formulas yield g=x^(-1), w=x, eta=Inn(p), beta=theta and determinant -1 by direct substitution.
